d:
What is the hidden cost behind the shimmer found in cosmetics, electronics, and everyday products? This eye-opening documentary travels to the mica-rich region of Jharkhand, India, where families depend on dangerous mining work to survive. Through firsthand testimonies, investigations into global supply chains, and interviews with industry representatives, the film explores the complex links between poverty, natural resources, international trade, and corporate responsibility in one of the world's least visible industries.
Year: 2019
Production: CAT & Cie
Director: Brando Baranzelli
